name: clean-planner
description: Clean Planner / CleanSync — планировщик и челленджи домашней уборки

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n api,spa -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix web install
